Contractor Assistant

Official F-Droid-compatible repo for Contractor Assistant, a local-first job tracker for contractors. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://jimmyhoffs.github.io/contracta/repo
